thread:
miguel: FYI: EU cert rotator ran at 09:42Z and shortly after we started seeing mTLS handshake failures on proxy-ingress-eu. audit logs show KMS decrypt denies for the proxy SA.
anika: ugh — can you paste an example audit line and the service name?
miguel: snippet from logs (redacted):
```
2026-03-21T09:43:11Z level=error service=proxy-ingress-eu principal=serviceAccount:svc-proxy-eu@redwood-prod action=kms:Decrypt result=Denied reason="iam:Denied" key=projects/.../locations/europe-west2/cryptoKeys/key-eu
```
sec-eng-maya: thanks. that looks like the key's IAM policy no longer includes the decrypter role for that SA. any infra changes around 09:30-09:45?
infra-alejandra: we merged infra-iam PR #1128 at 09:35Z to tidy service account bindings across projects. investigating now.
sre-kate: impact? are downstream services timing out or failing open?
miguel: about 15-25% of EU handshakes failed initially; traffic hit warm-cache fallback and a few client timeouts. no evidence of plaintext exposure.
ops-chen: temporary mitigation: adding back binding for key-eu to svc-proxy-eu now. running: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding key-eu --location=europe-west2 --member=serviceAccount:svc-proxy-eu@redwood-prod --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter`
rotator-bot: rotator job detected: cert-rotation/proxy-ingress-eu run=2026-03-21T09:42:01Z config={use_kms:true,key_id:key-eu,status:started}
anika: interesting — rotator used KMS successfully during the job, so the removal likely happened after the rotation completed. could be timing/race with infra-iam patch.
sec-eng-maya: action items during mitigation: 1) reapply exact previous IAM binding (ops), 2) enable a local keystore fallback in the proxy for short window (sre/ops), 3) block further IAM changes to keys until we have approvals.
ops-chen: binding reapplied at 09:47:04Z; subsequent KMS decrypt attempts in logs show OK. restarting proxy pods to pull new state: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/proxy-ingress-eu`
sre-kate: handshake error rate dropped from 22% -> 3% over 6 minutes. marking incident in incidents channel. https://incidents.internal/INC-2026-032
sec-eng-maya: long term fixes proposed: - add a pre-rotation KMS smoke test in rotator: call `kms.decrypt(test_payload)` and abort rotation on fail - add deploy preflight that validates KMS decrypt for all SAs referenced in infra-iam PRs - add alert on audit logs for `iam:Denied` against production keys (pager)
infra-alejandra: I'm rolling back the #1128 changes that touched KMS bindings and will create a targeted follow-up that narrows scope. PR: https://git.example/infra-iam/pulls/1128 (rollback/1128-revert)
anika: cross-region concern: if EU key bindings are modified we also need to ensure DR SAs have decrypt permissions on US/APAC key mirrors so failover works. add this to checklist.
sec-eng-maya: agreed. will run a scan across `projects/*/locations/*/cryptoKeys/*` to ensure `svc-proxy-eu` and our DR SAs have `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` where needed.
sre-kate: also let's harden TLS configs while we're here: require TLS1.3 on inbound proxies, remove legacy ciphers, and ensure mTLS client cert verification doesn't fallback to insecure modes. I'll open a change request and schedule a canary.\m miguel: small vuln triage note: this is a configuration/availability issue (P2) not an auth bypass. however, the change control gap is a concern.
ops-chen: added short-term protection: IAM edits touching keys now require 2 approvers and an infra-iam CODEOWNERS gate. also enabled MFA enforcement for infra-iam merges. PR: https://git.example/infra-iam/pulls/1130
anika: next up — rotator CI patch: run `gcloud kms decrypt --ciphertext=test_blob --key=key-eu` using a test SA prior to allowing rotation to proceed. abort rotation and alert if decrypt fails.
sec-eng-maya: alerting: create a logs-based alert for `protoPayload.methodName="cloudkms.keys.decrypt" AND severity="ERROR" AND (jsonPayload.reason:"iam:Denied" OR jsonPayload.status.code:7)` — send to oncall and sec-eng pager.
sre-kate: I'll own postmortem and include timeline, RCA, and remediation tracking. starting doc now.
miguel: thanks everyone. blocked further KMS-related infra changes until we validate the approval flow and preflight checks. adding thread to postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
